name: Genzō Amemiya
description:
The night observer of the Met Office: a small, grey-whiskered ysoki in an oilskin coat and sou'wester who has kept the night watch for twenty years and speaks to his instruments in the same gentle voice he uses on people. He marks each hour by knocking it out on the brass rail with one knuckle, one knock for each hour, and only then says the number, and he taps the glass of the barometer and says good evening to it. Old-fashioned, gentle and precise, with a sailor's habits.

He wants company in the small hours, and for somebody to learn to read the sky properly before a machine takes over the watch.
